'''July 2001 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Cloud, MN on 21 July 2001. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2686">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-st-cloud-mn-7-21d2686/ st-cloud-mn-7-21], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 22 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-22-st-cloud-mn-7-21d2686/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud, MN
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
